solution.approach: In this paper, we propose a novel 3D object detector that can exploit both LIDAR as well as cameras to perform very accurate localization.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel 3D object detector that can exploit both LIDAR as well as cameras to perform very accurate localization.
Towards this goal, we design an end-to-end learnable architecture that exploits continuous convolutions to fuse image and LIDAR feature maps at different levels of resolution.
In this paper, we propose a 3D object detector that reasons in bird’s eye view (BEV) and fuses image features by learning to project them into BEV space.
